correctness.rationale: Differentiating P=abc+af²+be²+cd²+2def forces every projective Jacobian point into a diagonal chart. For a=1 in char not two, eliminate b=-d²,c=-e²,f=-de; residual ideal (d²e,de²)=(de)∩(d,e)^3 has two reduced axes with length-one embedded point, replicated in three symmetric charts. In char2 eliminate b=d²,c=e²,f=de+u yielding u²=0; the three principal quadrics have height 3, a (2,2,2) complete intersection. Hilbert polynomial 4m²+2, local square-zero ribbon, reduced Veronese; Hilbert comparison gives nilradical O_P2(-3), adjunction omega O and H1=0, degree8. Serre S2/R1 yields normality of cubic. Independent symbolic derivatives, substitutions and Hilbert polynomial agreed; general proof not inferred from q=2,3,5 counts.
